name: Sonangol
desc: Angola's state-owned oil and gas group covering exploration, production, refining, fuel distribution, trading and shipping.
products: crude oil, natural gas, refined fuels, trading and shipping
customers: oil buyers, Angolan fuel consumers and businesses
markets: Angola; offices or operations in Singapore, UK, USA, Brazil, Iraq, DR Congo, Cape Verde, São Tomé and Príncipe
expansion_markets: Partial privatisation planned: 30% of shares to be offered by 2027 (Ministry of Finance plan, April 2020)

signals.what: 2025 annual report and accounts published; first-half 2025 management report published; Sonangol 2023-2028 bond coupon notice (no new event of note)

fit_rationale: Large African national oil company with trading arms in Singapore, London and Houston; hospitality could serve trading counterparties, but no Grand Prix in Angola, governance history weighs on brand, and the fuel category is crowded.
category_conflict: potential: fuel and lubricant partners already in F1 (Aramco, Shell, Petronas, ExxonMobil and others)
f1_markets: Singapore, United Kingdom, United States, Brazil

access.roles: Chairman and CEO; Board of Directors; Communications and Image department

compliance: Wikipedia records historic bribery and embezzlement cases: 2020 Swiss court finding of bribes to Sonangol officials (2005-2008); former chair Isabel dos Santos convicted in June 2023 of embezzling EUR 52.6m; 2021 bribery charge against a former Sonangol Distribuidora CEO linked to Trafigura. Needs compliance review before approach.
outstanding: Profitability; status of the partial privatisation/IPO; current marketing structure; compliance clearance.

name: Barry's
desc: Private equity-backed boutique fitness chain running high-intensity treadmill and strength classes in about 89 studios across 15 countries.
products: group fitness classes, at-home workouts, apparel, studio fuel bars
pe_swf_owner: North Castle Partners (majority since July 2015); Princeton Equity Group (strategic investment partner announced January 2025)
marketing_autonomy_basis: standalone brand with its own CEO and co-CEO (Wikipedia)
markets: United States, Canada, UK and Europe (Norway, Denmark, Sweden, Italy, Spain and others), Middle East (UAE, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain) and Australia
exception_note: Revenue USD 100m (2023) sits in the Route B band; support: private equity backing (North Castle Partners majority, new investment partner Princeton Equity Group in January 2025) and an international footprint of 89 studios in 15 countries.

signals.what: Princeton Equity Group announced as strategic investment partner

fit_rationale: Premium fitness brand in Miami, Las Vegas-adjacent US cities, London, Abu Dhabi, Doha, Melbourne and Toronto overlaps many race cities; F1 fan activations and driver-fitness content suit it, but budgets are small.
f1_markets: United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Spain, Italy, UAE, Qatar, Bahrain, Australia

access.roles: CEO; Co-CEO; Chief Marketing Officer (not named on pages opened)

outstanding: Current revenue; marketing budget; marketing lead.
